De Stul. Furniture Brand
Furniture, redefined by technology

A brand of furniture printed on a 3D printer using innovative wood printing technologies. The brand is based in Oakland, California. De Stul offers a wide range of different one-of-a-kind furniture that is both art and home decor.

Can analysis of a person's interior give a complete picture of a person? No.
To fully understand personality, it is necessary to consider the interior in the context of other factors, such as behavior, relationships with other people.

This calendar is dedicated to the photoelectric effect*, which was explained in 1905 by Albert Einstein based on Max Planck's hypothesis about the quantum nature of light.

There are four main periods of the year: low energy, solar activity, peak energy, and trough energy. Depending on the strength of the sun, a different number of photons reach the earth, which directly affects the strength of the photoelectric effect. Each season represents a phase of the photoelectric effect in the annual cycle.

*The photoelectric effect is the interaction of light or any other electromagnetic radiation with matter, in which the energy of the photons is transferred to the electrons of the matter.

Depending on the strength of the sun's activity and the number of photons reaching the surface at any given time of year, the black balance in the graphic changes
against the background, which envelops the bare metal sheet, altering the interaction area of ​​electromagnetic radiation with the surface.

contentBlocks.content: A documentary photo series dedicated to skaters in a moment of pause. Looking back from the event, you can see the world from a completely different perspective. Instead of flashy tricks, there are tired looks, warm concrete and dirty plywood, dusty palms and idle conversations stretched out between runs. A skatepark is not only a place for skating, but also a space for communication, observation, silent understanding of each other and a vibrant FIFA rink. The project captures such moments, forcing us to see that skateboarding is not just a movement, but also people frozen in its rhythm. Moreover, in March 2025, Sababa closed and ceased to exist for an unknown period. The series documents the last days of the sixth Sababa, which no one will ever see again.

contentBlocks.content: The Crypto Anarchist Manifesto by Timothy May is a short but powerful text written in 1988, which is considered the ideological foundation of the entire crypto-anarchist movement. The graphics actively use techniques that prevent the text from being easily read, continuing the idea of anonymity. There is also pervasive pixelation, referencing the dawn of the internet.

A specter is haunting the modern world, the specter of crypto anarchy. Interactions over networks will be untraceable, via extensive re-routing of encrypted packets. These developments will alter completely the nature of government regulation, the ability to tax and control economic interactions. Arise, you have nothing to lose but your barbed wire fences!

title: Trash Aesthetics. Visual Culture of Waste

contentBlocks.content: Trash creates a unique aesthetic—chaos, wear and tear, random combinations of shapes and materials. This expressiveness is increasingly being used in fashion, advertising, and art as a source of new visual solutions. Could trash become a fully-fledged visual language of popular culture?

Garbage, one way or another, is perceived as something base and unpleasant. In this form, it can never enter the masses. Nevertheless, with certain transformations, and especially with claims of recycling or aestheticization, waste becomes a fully-fledged visual language of popular culture.

contentBlocks.content:
«Дымшиц и партнеры» — консалтинговая компания, которая специализируется на маркетинговых исследованиях. С 2001 года визуальные коммуникации бренда не менялись и порядком устарели за это время. Михаил Дымшиц обратился к нам с задачей — обновить визуальный язык бренда так, чтобы сохранить дух серьезной консалтинговой фирмы, но добавить огня.

Цифры, графики, таблицы Excel и презентации в Power Point — типичная среда, в которой работает компания «Дымшиц и партнеры». Профессионалы компании доверяют только фактам, которые получают с помощью данных опросов, интервью и тестов. Мы сформулировали позиционирование бренда — «Маркетинг, основанный на фактах». Метафора: «Весь мир — данные».

Мы взяли системные шрифты Arial и Times New Roman, добавили к ним генеративную графику с цветовой палитрой Excel и выжали всё на максимум! Логотип «Дымшиц и партнеры» — это старый добрый Times New Roman, который мы модифицировали, чтобы придать ему больше строгости, дерзости и уникальности.

Каждый носитель содержит факты о себе. На конвертах указан размер и вес бумаги, в папке для бумаг указаны её формат, а фирменные футболки и галстуки запечатаны текстами про размер и материалы. Разработали сайт компании, который намеренно похож на документ, сверстанный по ГОСТ и наполнили его генеративной графикой, которая напоминает о больших объемах данных.​​​​​​​

contentBlocks.content:
The Garbage Museum is a contemporary art museum where trash becomes an artistic statement.

This is the BÜRO art group's space in the Kaluga and Kaliningrad regions. Its collection features over 600 works by artists from 25 countries, created from recycled materials and waste. The museum explores the value in what is typically considered unnecessary, expanding the boundaries of material and form through contemporary artistic expression.

contentBlocks.content: The new positioning conveys the Museum's value through artistic expression. It conveys the idea that art doesn't have to be perfect and glossy; it exists for everyone and can express meaning and emotion even through trash. Furthermore, the exhibition and the museum's positioning have an environmental subtext that runs through all aspects without being intrusive.

A museum is a system in which every discovered object is assigned a new code. The identity visualizes not the object, but its re-encoding. Once in the museum space, trash acquires meaning, beginning to speak for itself.

To visualize this idea, a generative typography tool was developed for creating fonts with unique glyph states. The symbols are assembled from abstract particles, referencing the creation of art objects from waste. Rotating both the sculpture and the font creates a radically different sensory experience.
